finalText:
**`Redis` died. Everything after it is fallout.**

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis` refused at `10.0.0.12:6379` ([app.log:182](logs/app.log:182)) |
| 02:14:08 | Cache miss storm, store timeouts start |
| 02:29:12 | Queue depth 502, over max 500 |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` heap out of memory |
| 02:31:52 | `api` killed. Service down |

13 reconnect tries all failed. They ran every 80s flat. No backoff, so the store never got slack.

Heads up. The log is dated 2026-07-04, not last night.

Next: find why `10.0.0.12:6379` refuses.
